editorial.blurb: A Vietnamese haven in Oak Lawn where regulars return 50+ times for richly flavored, consistently excellent pho and fresh spring rolls that rival expectations.
editorial.insiderTip: Order a small pho tai with chicken skewers and a rice bowl for the classic combo that keeps regulars coming back; ask to swap egg rolls for spring rolls if you avoid pork.
